name: Run over people with cars simulator
desc:
Welcome to Run Over People With Cars Simulator!

Unleash chaos in this wild driving game! Your mission: run over as many NPCs as possible to earn money. Upgrade your car for more speed and power, making it even more destructive. Use your earnings to unlock new cars with unique abilities and bonuses.

🚗 Upgrade Cars: Enhance speed and strength for maximum mayhem.
💰 Earn Money: The more NPCs you hit, the more you earn.
🛣️ Explore Maps: Navigate different areas filled with NPCs.
🏆 Leaderboards: Compete to be the ultimate driving menace.
🚗 Unlock New Cars: Collect unique cars with special abilities.

Ready to become the ultimate driving menace? Join the chaos and start your rampage in Run Over People With Cars Simulator today!

scripts.script:
while true do
    game.ReplicatedStorage.Events.UpgradeEvent:FireServer("MoneyGain")
    game.ReplicatedStorage.Events.UpgradeEvent:FireServer("NPCS")
    game.ReplicatedStorage.Events.PlayEvent:FireServer()
    wait(.3)
    for i, v in workspace.Npcs:GetChildren() do
        local car = workspace.Cars:WaitForChild(game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("CurrentCar"))
        if v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            v.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = car:WaitForChild("Hitbox").CFrame
        end
        game.ReplicatedStorage.Events.UpgradeEvent:FireServer("MoneyGain")
        wait(.05)
    end
end
